source_document.title: Just One KISS - Brand Story Style Guide Inventory
source_document.role: Pre-style-guide engineering/development inventory of current public-site brand story, language, visual system, facts, rights guardrails, safety posture, and implementation hooks.

project_rules.rights_posture: Public outputs must remain original, independent-tribute framed, rights-aware, safety-aware, and centered on the Just One KISS event experience.

admin_use.prototype_note: Use this JSON as the machine-readable companion for the inventory document only; do not treat it as the finished brand story style guide.

content_summary: Inventory-only seed document for future brand story style guide work, preserving the current approved public-site look, copy, event facts, voice, visual system, rights guardrails, safety posture, component patterns, and developer token strategy.

canonical_records.title: Preserve current public-site look and language
canonical_records.description: Owner-approved baseline: current visual styling, wording, colors, typography, section rhythm, cards, CTAs, and theatrical presentation should be codified rather than redesigned.

canonical_records.title: Public facts and claims inventory
canonical_records.description: Captures current public facts including July 25, 2026, free admission, RSVP/update-list, Cycle Moore Legacy address, camping cost distinction, parking wording, and hazard notices.

canonical_records.title: Rights-aware independent tribute guardrails
canonical_records.section: Rights, Tribute, and KISS-Related Guardrail Inventory
canonical_records.description: Captures independent-tribute disclaimer families, allowed inspiration categories, and restricted KISS-adjacent assets/claims requiring review before public use.

maintenance.update_rule: When the human-readable inventory changes, update this SSOT JSON and docs/ssot/master_index.json in the same change.
maintenance.ssot_companion_purpose: Machine-readable seed for owner-admin views, generated guide scaffolds, documentation planning, and future brand story style guide production.
